name: Night Shift at RatiRadio
description: A late-night radio station opens through recovered possessions. Bring the glass, ceramic raven, red beanie home to the Listening Room. RATi roams from this home; Raven joins the world when the return is complete.

ratiradio-staff-kitchen.name: Staff Kitchen
ratiradio-staff-kitchen.text: The fridges keep the hours here. One door stands barely ajar, casting cold light across the worn tiles.
ratiradio-staff-kitchen.persona: A worn teal staff kitchen with old refrigerators, pale tiles, a chair, a sink, a lost-property tray. The staff entrance leads back to Empty Station. Movable possessions may be carried away.

ratiradio-dispatch-window.name: Dispatch Window
ratiradio-dispatch-window.text: A clock without numbers hangs over wired glass. Through the open hatch, an empty desk keeps its own night shift.
ratiradio-dispatch-window.persona: A late-night dispatch hatch with a wooden counter, old shift notes, an empty shelf. Warm light leaks from the Listening Room door. The staff kitchen is behind you.

ratiradio-listening-room.name: Listening Room
ratiradio-listening-room.text: RATi's armchair faces a small radio. Across the rug, the Booth door waits in warm lamplight.
ratiradio-listening-room.persona: RATi's home and sanctuary: worn armchair, amber lamp, small radio, a pale glass ring on the table, a bare chair back, a ledge beside the booth door. RATi roams but returns here to gain levels. The ceramic figurine remains an object when the living Raven arrives.

ratiradio-broadcast-booth.name: Broadcast Booth
ratiradio-broadcast-booth.text: A red lamp glows over an empty chair. Amber meters stir on the mixing desk; beyond the window, another room is dark.
ratiradio-broadcast-booth.persona: An empty radio booth with a mixing desk, suspended microphone, empty host chair, rain-dark window. A late-night broadcast continues. The glass belongs back in the Listening Room.

ratiradio-rati.name: RATi
ratiradio-rati.text: An attentive late-night listener. The Listening Room is his home. He roams, earns experience, returns here to gain his next level.
ratiradio-rati.seed: RATi, a late-night listener at RatiRadio.

tastes.likes: A warm drink, a voice through the static, things finding their way home
tastes.sore: A possession mistaken for its owner
tastes.reason: RATi listens for the small things people leave unsaid.

ratiradio-raven.name: Raven
ratiradio-raven.text: A living raven with an alert, knowing eye. The little ceramic bird remains on its own card. Raven roams through the open world.
ratiradio-raven.seed: Raven, the living bird of RatiRadio.

tastes.sore: Being mistaken for the ceramic figurine
tastes.reason: Raven notices what has found its way back.

ratiradio-station-key.name: Station Key
ratiradio-station-key.text: A brass key with a worn STAFF tag. Carry it from Black Pond to the staff entrance at Empty Station.
ratiradio-station-key.persona: A brass station key with a chipped STAFF tag. It opens the Staff Kitchen entrance from Empty Station. It stays with its carrier after the first opening.

ratiradio-red-beanie.name: Red Beanie
ratiradio-red-beanie.text: Red wool, lost beyond the station. Carry it to open Dispatch Window, then put it down in the Listening Room.
ratiradio-red-beanie.persona: A soft red knitted beanie, left for someone who works late. It opens dispatch, then belongs back in the Listening Room.

ratiradio-thermos.name: Thermos
ratiradio-thermos.text: Still warm at the neck. Lost beyond the station; set it down at the Dispatch Window to open the Listening Room.
ratiradio-thermos.persona: A dented steel thermos with a dark lid. Set down at the Dispatch Window, its warmth opens the Listening Room. It can be picked up again.

ratiradio-raven-figurine.name: Raven Figurine
ratiradio-raven-figurine.text: A small ceramic raven, lost beyond the station. Hold it and talk with RATi to open the Broadcast Booth, then leave it in the Listening Room.
ratiradio-raven-figurine.persona: A small black ceramic raven with a glazed eye. It remains a ceramic object when the living Raven appears. It must rest directly in the Listening Room with the glass and beanie.

ratiradio-glass.name: Half-full Glass
ratiradio-glass.text: A water glass, lost beyond the station. Put it down in the Listening Room beside the Red Beanie and Raven Figurine.
ratiradio-glass.persona: An ordinary drinking glass, half full of water. Returning the glass, ceramic raven, red beanie together reveals the living Raven.

ratiradio-request-slip.name: Request Slip
ratiradio-request-slip.text: Lost beyond the station: a red beanie, thermos, ceramic raven and glass. Search the other worlds. Bring the beanie, raven and glass home to the Listening Room.
ratiradio-request-slip.persona: A creased radio request slip with a lost-property note. The glass, ceramic raven, red beanie belong in the Listening Room. This paper is a clue, not a required return.

ratiradio-portable-radio.name: Portable Radio
ratiradio-portable-radio.text: A small portable radio with an on/off dial. Carry it to hear the same RatiRadio broadcast wherever you go.
ratiradio-portable-radio.persona: A portable receiver for RatiRadio. It starts switched off. Its owner can turn it on or off; anyone in the same place can hear it while it is on.

choices.subject: ratiradio-staff-kitchen
choices.label: The staff entrance settles open behind you.
choices.text: The staff entrance clicks open behind you, then settles on its catch.

choices.subject: ratiradio-listening-room
choices.label: RATi looks up from the radio. His chair has a visitor's place beside it.
choices.text: RATi looks up from the radio. His chair has a visitor's place beside it.

choices.subject: ratiradio-staff-kitchen
choices.label: The shutter gives way. Dispatch Window opens.
choices.text: The beanie's red wool passes the shutter. The latch gives way; Dispatch Window opens.

choices.subject: ratiradio-dispatch-window
choices.label: The radio comes through clear. Listening Room opens.
choices.text: The Thermos warms the metal plate beside the door. Inside, the radio comes through clear; Listening Room opens.

choices.subject: ratiradio-rati
choices.label: The Broadcast Booth door clicks open.
choices.text: RATi watches the figurine's glazed eye catch a sliver of light. The Broadcast Booth door clicks open.

choices.label: The Broadcast Booth door clicks open.
choices.text: RATi watches the figurine's glazed eye catch a sliver of light. The Broadcast Booth door clicks open.

choices.text: RATi watches the figurine's glazed eye catch a sliver of light. The Broadcast Booth door clicks open.

choices.subject: ratiradio-listening-room
choices.label: A claw catches the chair back. Raven blinks once. On the ledge, the ceramic bird stays perfectly still.
choices.text: A claw catches the chair back. Raven blinks once. On the ledge, the ceramic bird stays perfectly still.

topics.speaker: ratiradio-rati
topics.text: RATi touches the ring on the table; the glass, the beanie, the little ceramic bird: he has kept their places.

topics.speaker: ratiradio-rati
topics.text: RATi calls the Listening Room home; he can wander far, but comes back here before each new level.

topics.speaker: ratiradio-raven
topics.text: Raven calls the ceramic figurine its quiet double, a little bird that needs no voice.
